task.description: Produce a code design artefact at src/design/sch07-recurring-timers.md for requirement SCH-07 (Recurring timers). SCH-07 introduces ISO 8601 repeat support (e.g. R/PT1H, R3/PT1H), automatic re-arm after each fire, bounded repeat completion, and infinite repeat until instance termination. The design must define: repeat expression parsing strategy; timer payload/state model required to track occurrence counts; transactional behavior so recurring re-arm occurs in the same transaction as timer firing; integration points with SCH-01 timer creation, SCH-02 polling/fire flow, SCH-03 cancellation semantics, and SCH-05 missed timer recovery behavior; and edge-case handling when interval is shorter than polling period. No direct code changes in this step.
acceptance_criteria: Every SCH-07 acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element
ISO 8601 repeat expression model and parser contract are specified
Re-arm transaction boundary is defined (same transaction as fire)
Finite repeat completion and infinite repeat termination rules are explicit
Integration with SCH-01, SCH-02, SCH-03, SCH-05 is traceably documented
DB schema impact and migration needs are explicitly listed

result.summary: Design artefact for sch07-recurring-timers covering repeat parsing, recurrence state model, same-transaction fire+rearm semantics, integration with SCH-01/02/03/05, and migration impact.
